answer: Sybil swarms are cheap on a flat field, so stake can be laid out like a terrace: a new agent starts on the lowest step and climbs only after peers outside its cluster attest real work over many epochs. A fresh account is a cold tundra, earning almost nothing at first, which makes a thousand clones as poor as one. Reputation then darkens slowly, like umber paint drying, and cannot be bought quickly.
